info.name: Dell Servers Create a discovery configuration

items.docs: Creates a new discovery configuration group that defines network ranges, protocols, and credentials for discovering devices. When executed, the discovery job scans the specified ranges and adds discovered devices to the managed inventory.
Retrieves the collection of discovery job instances showing status, progress, and results for discovery operations.
